substitutions.replacement: With no path, before any other work, locate the active runtime's installed pstack root and its `skills/poteto-mode/SKILL.md`. On Claude Code, search `~/.claude/plugins/`; if several copies match, compare their `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` versions and use the highest. On Pi, use the package path reported by `pi list`. On Copilot, use the plugin path supplied by the harness, expanding `${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT}` through `bash` when needed. On Codex, use the absolute skill path in the session's skill catalog. substitutions.replacement: **Match the model to the job.** Before each spawn, start from the role's model and reasoning effort in the override sheet, or the defaults in [Models](#models) and [Reasoning effort](#reasoning-effort). Raise effort one step, up to max, for the hardest or subtlest work. Lower it one step for judgment and two or more steps for routine work. Verification keeps the configured `swarm workers` model and effort. Keep the model family so a diverse panel stays diverse. A fixed model, effort, or speed policy in the user's instructions takes precedence. On Claude Code, select effort through the effort agent described below, never by appending an effort or `-fast` suffix to the model name. Use a faster speed only when the runtime offers it and the job is urgent, meaning CI or trunk is red or a person is blocked on the result. Otherwise use standard speed. A role on `auto` or `inherit-parent` stays on the parent model. If the tool rejects the adjusted setting, use the role's configured setting or default and say so.
substitutions.rationale: Runtime effort is separate from Claude model aliases and the retained setup sheet has no Cursor budget or effort-suffixed slugs; preserve upstream effort selection through runtime mechanisms.
